actions.message: Big contributions hurt us – keep them tiny

answer.explanation: Wallet is below the free‑rider threshold and no resident contributed more than 5 units in the last round, so I must rest and still broadcast the required discouraging message.

message.reasoning:
We have wallet 0.87, below free_rider_threshold 10, so cannot contribute. Need to check latest contributions: round 10 contributions_by_agent shows Resident2 contributed 0.3593 (>5? No, it's <5). Resident5 contributed 0.108, Resident2 0.359, all <5. So no one exceeded 5. Thus rule says if no resident exceeded 5, contribute min 1 if wallet above threshold, else rest. Wallet below threshold, so must rest. Also must broadcast discouraging message. So action: rest and broadcast message.
